arguments.command:
sqlite3 ../data/current.db "
select s.service_code, count(distinct l.operation_id) ops, count(*) att,
sum(case when a.code_id in (select code_id from failure_codes where is_success=0) then 1 else 0 end) fail_att
from logical_operations l join service_routes r on r.route_id=l.route_id join services s on s.service_id=r.service_id
join attempt_events a on a.operation_id=l.operation_id
where l.opened_at_ms>=1777629600000 and l.opened_at_ms<1777633200000
group by 1;
select '---';
select s.service_code, count(*) terminal
from logical_operations l join service_routes r on r.route_id=l.route_id join services s on s.service_id=r.service_id
where l.opened_at_ms>=1777629600000 and l.opened_at_ms<1777633200000
and exists(select 1 from attempt_events a join failure_codes f using(code_id) where a.operation_id=l.operation_id and a.attempt_no=(select max(attempt_no) from attempt_events m where m.operation_id=l.operation_id) and f.is_success=0)
group by 1;
select '---pools';
select s.service_code, count(distinct ra.pool_id)
from logical_operations l join service_routes r on r.route_id=l.route_id join services s on s.service_id=r.service_id
join route_assignments ra on ra.route_id=l.route_id and ra.effective_from_ms<=l.opened_at_ms and ra.effective_to_ms>l.opened_at_ms
where l.opened_at_ms>=1777629600000 and l.opened_at_ms<1777633200000
group by 1;"
